text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall despite several declines, so I should judge decisions over a meaningful horizon rather than react to one month’s return.","Selling Stock B and Stock A at gains felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each position’s outlook and portfolio role.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should use a consistent plan for position sizes and rebalancing instead of letting loss aversion or the pleasure of locking in gains drive trades."]}
